verdict.rationale: Qdrant's GitHub README lists official client libraries for Go, Rust, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, .NET/C# and Java. The quickstart shows SDK usage (client.create_collection), and a community user reports smooth onboarding with the Python client. missing for 10: per-SDK in-depth reference documentation in the evidence, and independent corroboration for the non-Python SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Qdrant offers the following client libraries to help you integrate it into your application stack
Go client ... Rust client ... JavaScript/TypeScript client ... Python client ... .NET/C# client ... Java client
Just played with qdrant using its Python client. Pretty smooth onboarding experience
